Commentary.Commentary: Back for the chase. The English players are out in the middle. Stephan Pascal and Adrian Weir to open for the Windies.
...THE CHASE...

For England, it was a struggle, they kept losing wickets whenever a batter got going. Hamza Shaikh was the only one who crossed the 50-run mark but for the rest, it was a really struggle to get going. In the end, we feel, they have a score which is below par. Yes, the wicket is gripping but 220 would have probably been par. Windies will back themselves to chase this down. England on the other hand, will need wickets if they are to defend this. Chase coming up shortly. Stay tuned.

A really good effort from the Windies and they will be very happy with the effort they have put in so far. The pacers were excellent to begin with, the likes of Nathan Edward and Isai Thorne were excellent and then the spinners made life difficult for the England batters. Tarrique Edward and Nathan Sealy really applied the brakes and built the pressure. The key for the Windies was, they kept taking wickets at regular intervals and that never let England step on the gas. Their bowlers have justified their decision by the skipper at the toss.
OUT! CAIGHT! There is the last wicket. Shorter and outside off, Farhan Ahmed looks to cut, it goes off the toe-end and it is taken in the point region. England Under-19 HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 192!

Games from the Under 19 World Cup are coming thick and fast and it is time for yet another one, it is the Windies taking on England. England have been the best side in this group so far winning both the games they’ve played. Windies are just below them in the ranking having won one out of the two played. England Under-19 takes on West Indies Under-19 in their final game of pool B at the JB Marks Oval, Potchefstroom. England Under-19 is unbeaten with 4 points in their kitty while West Indies Under-19 have shared results with a defeat to start and a victory in the last game. The game becomes all-important as the sides will be carrying the points through with both sides going through. England Under-19 have won both games against Scotland Under-19 and South Africa Under-19. Ben McKinney has been the best batter for the English side and has led the top-order well. With Noah Thain, Hamza Shaikh, Jaydn Denly and others around chipping in with some crucial runs. The side does carry a lethal bowling attack with the likes of Farhan Ahmed, Luc Benkenstein, Eddie Jack and others with wicket-taking abilities in abundance. England Under-19 have all the attributes to stay unbeaten throughout the pool games and vitally carry 4 points to the next round. West Indies Under-19 on the other hand are in a situation of bother concerning the next round of games. The side is well placed to advance through but they are staring at a situation where they could be in with 0 points to their name to start the next round. The side won against Scotland Under-19 but they will be playing a difficult game against the Proteas and are not the favorites to advance. Jewel Andrew has been the shining star of the Caribbean as he stood tall for the side on both occasions but the side lost one where he scored a century and won the other against Scotland Under-19. The top-order needs to put up some fight against a quality opponent in England Under-19 if they are to stand a chance to win and carry a couple of points to the next round. The bowling will reply on the capable shoulder of Nathan Edward, Isai Thorne, Nathan Sealy and others. Will England Under-19 carry 4 points to the next stage or will the Carribeans take a couple with them? We shall find out soon.
